title: Source compatibilities from finite Tate balancing

proof.text: Write the specified source map as tensorator, scalar/pullback comparison and shifted line map. Each factor is invertible for arbitrary unbounded inputs. Naturality and cancellation of the published unit isomorphisms give the coefficient-unit and zero-power equations.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_tate_scalar_source_compatibilities_of_balancing [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (hB : (N : B) = 0)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (hX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (N : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (β : ∀ r : ℕ,
      (Etale.purityScalarSheaf φ X).obj (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateTwist X N A hA r) ≅
        Scheme.finiteEtaleTateTwist X N B hB r)
    (hβ : IsFiniteTateScalarBalancing φ N hA hB X β)
    (hline : IsFiniteTateScalarLineNormalized φ N hA hB X β) :
    IsFiniteTateScalarSourceInvertible φ N hA hB X β ∧
      IsFiniteTateScalarSourceUnitNormalized φ N hA hB X β ∧
      IsFiniteTateScalarSourceZeroNormalized φ N hA hB X β
